title: Your Pre-Entry Checklist
hook: The card prepares you to WAIT.

launchpad.outcome: Use a six-field pre-entry card that prepares you to wait, never one that approves a trade.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Am I ready to wait for ICC?

beats.title: Location
beats.line: Am I at or near an area that matters?

beats.title: Direction
beats.line: What side am I interested in?

beats.title: PIL
beats.line: What level must price prove itself through?

beats.title: Invalidation
beats.line: What would make this idea irrelevant?

slides.title: Are they ready?
slides.brief: 4H bullish, pulling back into discount. 1H higher low holding. Long only. Invalidation: a close below the 1H HL. The PIL? “I don’t really know my PIL, but I’ll know the setup when I see it.”

pil.value: “I’ll know it when I see it”
pil.why: They never named a level. “I’ll know it when I see it” isn’t a PIL.

ask.prompt: “I don’t really know my PIL, but I’ll know the setup when I see it.” What’s the problem?

options.label: That isn’t a rule-based plan
options.why: No PIL means no indication to wait for. The plan would be invented in the moment.

options.label: Nothing, experienced traders feel it
options.feedback: Feel isn’t a level. Without a PIL there’s nothing for price to prove.

options.label: They just need more confluence
options.feedback: Confluence can’t replace the level price must prove itself through.

slides.title: Does a full card mean “take the trade”?
slides.brief: Same chart. This time they named the PIL: 21,004.25, the swing high the pullback came from.

ask.prompt: All six fields are defined. What does the card say now?

options.label: 6/6: take the trade
options.feedback: It’s not a signal checklist. Nothing has happened at the PIL yet.

options.label: Ready to WAIT for ICC
options.why: The card prepares you to wait. Price still has to earn every step.

options.label: Enter at the PIL now
options.feedback: Nothing has indicated. The card doesn’t approve entries.

slides.quote: This card doesn’t approve a trade. It tells you what you’re waiting for.

slides.prompt: Why isn’t a complete pre-entry card a reason to enter?
slides.modelAnswer: Because it only defines the plan: context, structure, location, direction, PIL and invalidation. Then I wait for ICC. Price still has to earn the entry.

takeaways: Defined = READY TO WAIT. Never “take trade”.
remember: The card prepares you to wait.
